notes:
The DJ screen flashes when the rotation is changed somewhere else.

- When someone takes a girl off, puts her back on, adds a girl, or starts or kills a pole from an iPad or the Dance Counter window, the DJ screen flashes and lists the change at the top (who, when) until the DJ presses GOT IT. Her name is outlined in the rotation.
- If the DJ screen is behind another program, its taskbar button blinks.
- No sound plays, so nothing can end up on the speakers.
